newsitem.title: USA: In Home Health hospices certified.
newsitem.headline: In Home Health hospices certified.

text.p: In Home Health Inc said Wednesday that it received certification to offer hospice services in the Minneapolis and Pittsburgh markets under the Medicare program.
The number of markets in which In Home Health has hospice certification has grown to 12 today from one in 1995.
"Obtaining hospice certification under the Medicare program is a key step in becoming a more comprehensive health care provider," Mark Gildea, chief executive officer, said.
In Home Health, which provides skilled nursing, rehabilitation, infusion therapy and personal care services, now provides hospice services in over 60 percent of its markets.
